meta.description: Your recipe book: save, import, and share recipes on every device.

welcome.title: All your recipes, in one drawer.
welcome.lead: Snap the pages of grandma's cookbook, paste a link, or type it in. Mestolo keeps everything organized and ready on your phone, tablet, and computer.
welcome.point1: From photos of several pages, a link, or pasted text. You review everything before saving.
welcome.point2: Every recipe starts out visible only to you. You decide whether to share it with friends or everyone.
welcome.point3: Meal plan, shopping list, and servings rescaled in one tap.
welcome.deleted: Your account and all your data have been deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: Notice under Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). In short: your recipes are private until you decide otherwise, and we use your data only to run the service.
privacy.data: Account data: email and password (stored only as a hash by the authentication service), username, display name, bio. Content you create: recipes with history, images, notes, collections, shopping list, meal plan, friendships, declared dietary preferences (they may reveal religious beliefs or lifestyle: they are optional), reports and feedback. Usage data: count of AI feature uses, personal API keys (encrypted). Technical data: IP address and server logs, and error diagnostics (error type, page without parameters, browser and operating system). We do not collect location, contacts, advertising identifiers or browsing history; GPS metadata is removed from photos.
privacy.purposes: a) Creating and managing your account and providing app features (recipes, collections, sharing with friends, import from photos, links and videos, AI features you request); b) sending service emails (confirmation, password recovery); c) security, abuse prevention and moderation of reported content; d) monitoring and fixing technical errors; e) complying with legal obligations. We do not profile users, show advertising or track you across apps and sites.
privacy.basis: Performance of a contract or of steps you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) for the account and app features, including AI features you start; legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) for security, abuse prevention and error monitoring, with minimal data and no recipe content; legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) where applicable. For optional dietary preferences the basis is your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time by removing them in settings.
privacy.visibility: Every new recipe is private. You can make it visible to confirmed friends or to all registered users. Permissions are checked by the database on every request, including for images. Personal notes, collections, lists and meal plans are always private. Recipes imported from external sites stay private by default.
privacy.recipients: We process data through providers appointed as processors: Supabase (database, authentication and file storage); the app hosting provider (for example Vercel); Sentry (error and performance diagnostics, scrubbed data only: no emails, cookies or recipe text; no session recording; only a sample of performance data); the SMTP service for service emails. If you use AI features, the necessary data is sent to the provider you choose (for example Anthropic or OpenAI), see the next section. Meal reminder notifications in the native app are local to the device and do not go through a server; for web push notifications see the dedicated section. We do not sell data or share it with third parties for advertising.
privacy.push: If you enable push notifications in your browser, we store the subscription endpoint and its encryption keys, linked to your account. We use them only to deliver the notifications you asked for (for example meal reminders). The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time by turning notifications off in the app settings or in the site permissions of your browser; the subscription is also deleted when you delete your account. To deliver them, the message goes through the push service of your browser (Google FCM, Mozilla or Apple, depending on browser and device), which receives the endpoint and the encrypted content of the notification and is an independent controller of its own processing. In the native app, reminders stay local on the device.
privacy.aiTitle: External AI services, photos and links
privacy.ai: Analysis, photo reading, translations, video transcription and images use external providers only when you start the feature: they receive only the necessary content (recipe text or a page photo) and process it under their own terms. Photos used to import a recipe are processed in memory and not stored by Mestolo. If you use your own API key, it is encrypted and never appears in the browser, logs or exports. When you import from a link, our server downloads the page you indicate. The camera is used only when you take a photo for import or for a recipe.
privacy.transfers: Some providers (Supabase, hosting, Sentry, AI providers) are companies based, or with sub-processors, in the United States. Storage and diagnostics data are hosted in the regions shown in the controller card; any transfer to non-EU countries relies on an adequacy decision (EU-US Data Privacy Framework) or Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 44 ff. GDPR). You can ask the controller for a copy of the safeguards.
privacy.retention: Account data and content are kept as long as you keep the account. After deletion, data is removed from the application immediately; provider backup copies may persist for the period set by the provider. Error events in Sentry are kept for a limited period (normally up to 90 days); technical logs for the time strictly needed for security.
privacy.security: Encrypted connections (HTTPS), database-level access controls, personal API keys encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), images resized and stripped of metadata, technical logs without recipe content, photos, tokens or keys.
privacy.rights: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability (JSON export from settings) and objection to processing based on legitimate interest (Arts. 15-22 GDPR), and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise them, write to the controller at the contacts above.
privacy.deletion: You can download all your data as JSON and permanently delete your account and all content at any time from Settings, Account and data.
privacy.complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante (www.garanteprivacy.it), or with the supervisory authority of your country of residence.
privacy.minors: The service is intended for people aged 14 or over. Below that age, the consent of the person holding parental responsibility is required.

terms.title: Terms of service and community rules
terms.lead: Mestolo is a place to share recipes. By using it you accept these terms and rules, which apply to everything you make visible to friends or to everyone.
terms.service: Mestolo lets you store, organize, import and share recipes, also with the help of AI tools. The service is provided by the controller shown above and may be changed or discontinued for technical or organizational reasons.
terms.conduct: No offensive, discriminatory, violent, sexual, harassing or misleading content, and no spam or unsolicited advertising.
terms.content: You are responsible for the recipes, texts and images you publish. Recipes are private until you choose to share them.
terms.rights: Share only content that is yours or that you have the right to share. Recipes imported from sites or books stay private by default: make them public only if you have the right to, always citing the source. You grant the controller a limited licence to host and display your content according to the visibility you choose, solely to provide the service.
terms.safety: Do not publish dangerous instructions. AI suggestions, nutrition values and substitutions are indicative and do not guarantee suitability for allergies, intolerances or diets.
terms.moderation: You can report a recipe and block a user at any time. Reports are reviewed; a recipe reported by several people is hidden pending review, and content that breaks the rules is removed.
terms.account: In case of serious or repeated violations the account may be suspended or deleted. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from settings.
terms.liability: The service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law and without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights, the controller is not liable for indirect damages or for content published by users.
terms.law: These terms are governed by Italian law. For consumers, the courts of their place of residence or domicile remain competent.
terms.changes: We may update these terms; material changes will be announced in the app. By continuing to use the service you accept the updated version.

pagination.error: Could not load more recipes. Check your connection.

notifications.title: Mestolo
notifications.settingsLead: Get a notification at the time you choose for the meals you have planned.
notifications.enableHint: On this device, for the meals in your weekly plan.
notifications.timeHint: Leave a time empty to skip the reminder for that meal.
notifications.timezoneNote: Times follow the time zone of this device.
notifications.permissionDenied: Notifications are not allowed: enable them in your device or browser settings.
notifications.subscribeFailed: Could not turn on notifications on this device.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. Try the app or an up-to-date browser.
notifications.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad notifications only work after adding Mestolo to the Home Screen (Share > Add to Home Screen, iOS 16.4 or later).
notifications.limitedSchedule: On this installation reminders are only checked once a day (around 08:00 UTC): reminders at other times may not arrive. For on-time reminders the administrator must schedule the route every 15 minutes.

cook.voiceDenied: Microphone not allowed: voice commands turned off.
cook.wakeUnsupported: The screen may turn off: keeping it awake is not supported here.
cook.noSteps: This recipe has no steps yet.
cook.assistEmpty: Ask a question about this recipe, for example “how do I know when it’s done?”.
cook.assistDictating: Dictation in progress: tap to stop
cook.assistUnavailable: The AI assistant is not available. Set up an AI key in settings to use it while you cook.
cook.assistOffline: You are offline: the assistant needs a connection. You can keep cooking as usual.
cook.assistDisclaimer: AI-generated answers may contain mistakes. No medical or allergy advice; when in doubt, choose the safer option.

collectionSharing.title: Share collection
collectionSharing.hint_private: Only you and the people you invite can see it.
collectionSharing.hint_friends: All your friends can see it.
collectionSharing.hint_public: Anyone with an account can see it using the link.
collectionSharing.linkNote: Private recipes stay visible only to their authors.
collectionSharing.noFriends: You have no friends to invite.

publicPage.toggleHint: Anyone will be able to find this recipe on Google and open it without an account. You can turn it off at any time.
publicPage.needsPublic: Set visibility to Public to enable the public page.
publicPage.ctaTitle: Your recipe book, always with you
publicPage.ctaLead: Create a free account to save this recipe, adapt it to your taste and plan your meals.

source.description: Text taken from the video description
source.captions: Text taken from the video captions
source.transcription: Text obtained by transcribing the audio

sourceHint.description: Check and fix the text below, then parse it. No cost: no AI needed.
sourceHint.captions: Captions and description combined. Speech can contain errors: check the text before parsing it.
sourceHint.transcription: Automatic transcription can contain errors: check the text before parsing it.

videoImport.none: No transcript is available for this video. Try the AI option by uploading the video file, or paste the recipe text below.
videoImport.uploadTitleCompact: No useful text? Transcribe a video file
videoImport.uploadLead: The audio is extracted on your device and transcribed with AI: the video itself is not sent or stored.
videoImport.needsAi: Requires a personal OpenAI key (AI settings) or the app's AI service with quota left.
videoImport.uploadLimits: Up to 8 minutes of audio and a 200 MB file. Uses one text AI quota.
videoImport.fileTooBig: The file is too large (200 MB maximum).

extract.too_long: The video is too long: 8 minutes maximum.
extract.decode_failed: I can't read the audio of this file. Try another format (MP4 or MOV) or paste the text.
extract.unsupported: This browser can't extract audio. Paste the recipe text.

feed.reasonFriend: a friend of yours published it
feed.reasonPopular: it is popular in the community
feed.reasonNew: it is new in the community
feed.coldStart: We don't know your tastes yet: here are the most liked and newest recipes. Save or publish a few recipes to get tailored suggestions.
feed.empty: When new public recipes or your friends' recipes arrive, you'll find them here.

richProfile.websiteHint: https links only. Shown on your profile with rel nofollow.
richProfile.visibilityHint: Name and username are always visible to other users; bio, avatar, location, website and cuisines follow this choice.
richProfile.selfNote_public: Your profile is visible to all Mestolo users. Only shared recipes are shown.
richProfile.selfNote_friends: Your full profile is visible to your friends only. Only shared recipes are shown.
richProfile.selfNote_private: Your profile is private: others see only your name and username.
richProfile.restricted: This profile is only visible to people allowed to see it.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.hint: Rate this recipe from 1 to 5 stars.
ratings.saved: Rating saved. Tap the star again to remove it.
ratings.summary: Average {avg} out of 5, {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}}
ratings.notEnough: Not enough ratings yet to show the average.

cookLog.noteHint: How did it go? Tweaks, tips, advice.
cookLog.visibility_recipeHint: Visible to everyone who can see the recipe.
cookLog.visibility_privateHint: Stays in your diary, even if the recipe is public.
cookLog.title: Cooked by the community
cookLog.count: {count, plural, =0 {Not cooked yet} one {Cooked # time} other {Cooked # times}}
cookLog.photoAlt: Photo of the dish cooked on {date}
cookLog.historyLead: Your diary: what you cooked and when, with your notes and photos.
cookLog.historyEmpty: When you cook a recipe, tap “I cooked it” to add it here.

invites.title: Invite friends
invites.lead: Create a link and share it: anyone who opens it and signs up becomes your friend automatically.
invites.linkOnce: This link is shown only once: copy it now.
invites.shareText: I am inviting you to Mestolo, the recipe book you share with friends.
invites.invalid: This invite is not valid, has expired or was revoked.
invites.landingLead: Sign up or log in to become their friend and see the recipes they share with you.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.lead: Tell us what is broken or what you would like. We read every message.
feedback.messageHint: 5 to 4000 characters. For a problem, tell us what you were doing.
feedback.adminLead: Messages from testers and users, newest first.
feedback.adminEmpty: There are no messages for this filter.

fileImport.title: Import from file
fileImport.lead: Upload a file exported from Mestolo: a single recipe or your full account export.
fileImport.fileHint: Accepted formats: mestolo.recipe/v1 and mestolo.account-export/v1. Recipes are imported as private; images, ratings and friendships are not imported.
fileImport.found: {count, plural, one {# recipe in the file} other {# recipes in the file}}
fileImport.skipped: {count, plural, one {# recipe skipped because it has no title.} other {# recipes skipped because they have no title.}}
fileImport.importAllHint: Recipes with the same title as one you already have are skipped: deselect the ones you do not want, and stop or resume at any time. They skip the review screen: they are saved as private and marked “Needs review”.

errors.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.unsupported_format: This file is not a Mestolo export.
errors.no_recipes: The file has no recipes that can be imported.
errors.too_large: The file is too large (10 MB max).

fileImport.stopped: Stopped after {done} recipes: {created} imported, {duplicates} already present, {failed} failed. Start again to resume: recipes already imported are skipped.
fileImport.failuresTitle: {count, plural, one {# recipe not imported} other {# recipes not imported}}

failReasons.rate_limited: Too many requests: try again in a few minutes.
failReasons.forbidden: You are not allowed to save: sign in again.
